content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Lakewood

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The CAPM requires a secondary degree and formal project management education—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma, associate degree, or equivalent, you meet the foundational requirement. Verify your education qualifications before proceeding.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. This intensive format covers the PMBOK Guide and core project management principles in a concentrated schedule. Active certified practitioners deliver real-world context throughout the curriculum.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 23-hour course, submit your CAPM application directly to PMI with proof of your education requirement. Pay the associated exam fee at the time of application. PMI will review and notify you of approval status.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation support to reinforce key concepts and test-taking strategies. Schedule your proctored CAPM exam once approved by PMI. The exam validates your readiness to manage projects and support professional teams.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning resources to support your continued growth in project management.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
